value.reason: The evidence is a config value, products.38.limitPerUser. It is a product setting for the most a single user can buy or redeem of product 38. It is not a government ID, biometric, financial account, health, child, authentication secret or contact data, and it does not identify any person. Since one category has to be chosen, Profile is the closest weak match because the setting covers per-user account limits. The real sensitivity is negligible.
